name: BK-NM-AMT
summary: BK-NM-AMT, or βk-NM-αMT, also known as β-keto-N-methyl-αMT or α,N-dimethyl-β-ketotryptamine, as well as 3-indoylmethcathinone, is a serotonin–dopamine releasing agent (SDRA) and putative entactogen of the tryptamine, α-alkyltryptamine, and β-ketotryptamine families.

pharmacology.text: BK-NM-AMT acts as a serotonin–dopamine releasing agent (SDRA). The EC50 values of BK-NM-AMT for monoamine release are 41.3 nM for serotonin and 92.8 nM for dopamine in rat brain synaptosomes, whereas it only induced 55% release of norepinephrine at a concentration of 10 μM. Along with certain other tryptamines, such as α-ethyltryptamine (αET), 5-chloro-αMT and 5-fluoro-αET, it is one of the few SDRAs known.

uses.en: It is a research compound studied for how it releases serotonin and dopamine, and as a possible entactogen. It has no medical use.
uses.zh: 它是研究用化合物，用於探討它如何釋放血清素與多巴胺，並作為可能的同感劑被研究，沒有醫療用途。
uses.zhHans: 它是研究用化合物，用于探讨它如何释放血清素与多巴胺，并作为可能的同感剂被研究，没有医疗用途。

fact.en: It can be read two ways: as a tryptamine with a keto group, or as a cathinone whose ring is an indole. Chemists sometimes call it 3-indolylmethcathinone for that reason.
fact.zh: 它可以從兩個角度理解：既是帶酮基的色胺，也是以吲哚為環的卡西酮。化學家因此有時稱它為 3-indolylmethcathinone。
fact.zhHans: 它可以从两个角度理解：既是带酮基的色胺，也是以吲哚为环的卡西酮。化学家因此有时称它为 3-indolylmethcathinone。
